page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sccc7.32xlarge is a dedicated compute-oriented instance belonging to the Super Computing Cluster family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors, providing 128 dedicated vCPUs. With a system memory capacity of 256.0 GB, the instance maintains a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU, aligning with workloads prioritized for parallel compute throughput over large memory footprints.

The hardware configuration operates on a KVM hypervisor without integrated GPU acceleration. It includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for all persistent file systems. For distributed node coordination and data movement, the instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

From an architectural efficiency standpoint, the provision of 128 dedicated cores with 64 Gbps networking delivers substantial compute concentration per host interface. A notable tradeoff is the total reliance on external storage, which requires architectural consideration to ensure storage latency matches computational throughput. The instance is suited for high-performance computing (HPC), clustered simulations, large-scale batch processing, and compute-heavy parallel workloads.
